title: Stage 05 Peer Review Gate
description: Stage 5 (Peer Code Review) gate. review.mode: panel (default) — workstream gates land at pipeline/gates/stage-05.<area>.json (one per area: backend, frontend, platform, qa) and the orchestrator merges them into pipeline/gates/stage-05.json. WRITTEN BY THE approval-derivation HOOK ONLY — never authored by an agent. The hook parses pipeline/code-review/by-<reviewer>.md for REVIEW: APPROVED / REVIEW: CHANGES REQUESTED markers and reconciles approvals/changes_requested on every save. PASS when approvals.length >= required_approvals AND changes_requested is empty. review.mode: adversarial (31.3, opt-in) — two workstream gates instead: pipeline/gates/stage-05.reviewer.json (from by-reviewer.md, all areas rolled into one gate — required[] below does not apply to it, it carries areas_reviewed/approved_areas/changes_requested instead) and pipeline/gates/stage-05.critic.json (from by-critic.md — carries mode/challenges/challenges_resolved, see properties below). The merged stage-05.json additionally surfaces challenges/challenges_resolved from the critic gate; PASS requires the reviewer gate PASS AND challenges_resolved.

mode.description: Present only on adversarial-mode workstream gates (stage-05.reviewer.json, stage-05.critic.json) and on the merged gate when adversarial mode produced it. Absent on panel-mode gates.

challenges.description: Critic-only (stage-05.critic.json, rolled onto the merged gate). One entry per '## Challenge <id>' section in by-critic.md: { id, file, line, claim, disposition, evidence_missing? }. disposition is forced to "unresolved" when file:line evidence is missing or unparseable.

challenges_resolved.description: Critic-only (stage-05.critic.json, rolled onto the merged gate). True iff every challenge's disposition is "resolved" (or there are none). The merged stage-05 gate PASSes only when the reviewer gate PASSes AND this is true.

area.description: Owning area for this review gate. Same value as the gate's workstream field; kept for backwards-compat with consumers that read 'area'. Reviewers must come from a different area; see .devteam/rules/pipeline.md §Stage 5.

review_shape.description: Scoped (one cross-area reviewer, required_approvals=1) when the diff is area-contained; matrix (the v1 cross-review, required_approvals=2) when it spans areas.

required_approvals.description: Approvals needed for PASS. The orchestrator pre-creates the gate with this set; the hook does not change it.

approvals.description: Reviewer names that emitted REVIEW: APPROVED for this area. Hook-managed; agents must not write directly.

changes_requested.description: Reviewers who emitted REVIEW: CHANGES REQUESTED. Non-empty blocks PASS regardless of approvals count.

escalated_to_principal.description: True after the two-round review limit fires and the principal is invoked for a binding ruling.

failure_reason.description: Hook-written on every FAIL update; absent on PASS. INSUFFICIENT_APPROVALS means quorum has not been reached but no reviewer has objected — run 'devteam derive-approvals' first (approvals may be stale), then add a missing area review if still failing. CHANGES_REQUESTED means at least one reviewer wrote REVIEW: CHANGES REQUESTED — see changes_requested[] and blockers[] for details.

action_required.description: Hook-written plain-language next step when failure_reason is INSUFFICIENT_APPROVALS. States how many more approvals are needed, reminds the operator to run 'devteam derive-approvals' first, and lists eligible reviewers (all mapped reviewer names not yet in approvals[]). Absent when status is PASS or failure_reason is CHANGES_REQUESTED.
